goal: Rank candidates by expected marginal cost of the next call plus the scarcity of their remaining cap, so a subscription allowance is drained deliberately rather than accidentally and pay-as-you-go credit is held for work that deserves it. Cost stays paramount; what changes is that the number is the marginal one, computed from the billing mode, the quota window and the cache-adjusted token estimate.
title: Rank by marginal cost and cap scarcity, not price per token
